# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/notes/{sha}

Get a note corresponding to a single commit from a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-299`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| sha | path | string | True |
| verification | query | boolean | False |
| files | query | boolean | False |

## Response

**200** — api.Note

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `message` | string | The content message of the git note |
| `commit` | api.Commit | The commit that this note is attached to |

- **422** — sha is not a valid git ref pattern
- **404** — commit or note does not exist

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| SHA must be a valid git ref pattern | validation | !git.IsValidRefPattern(sha) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| sha fails IsValidRefPattern | 422 | validationError | False |
| commit or note not found | 404 | notFound | False |

### Error Paths

- **sha fails IsValidRefPattern** → repo.GetNote → 422
- **commit not found** → repo.getNote → 404
- **note not found for commit** → repo.getNote → 404
